concerns.text: FR-002 – ‘System MUST administer the SART and Ospan cognitive tasks via a web interface…’ has no corresponding implementation task in tasks.md (no task creates or validates a web‑based administration pipeline).
FR-003 – ‘System MUST administer the PSS‑10 and PANAS questionnaires…’ is not covered by any task; tasks only generate synthetic baseline data and handle compliance logs.
FR-004 – ‘System MUST provide a daily logging interface…’ is absent; the only compliance‑related task (T009) parses logs but does not implement the user‑facing logging interface.
FR-006 specifies a Wilcoxon fallback triggered by a Shapiro‑Wilk p < 0.05, yet tasks T012‑T013 trigger the fallback only when bootstrapping fails, violating the methodological requirement.
FR-009 – a pilot validation of SART and Ospan (n=5) for response‑time ranges and scoring correctness – is not represented by any task in tasks.md.
FR-010 – explicit validation of self‑reported social‑media minutes (range 0‑1440 and flagging all‑zero entries) is only implied in T009; there is no dedicated task that asserts this validation step.
Success criteria SC‑001 (statistically significant reduction in SART commission errors with d ≥ 0.2) lack any verification task that checks the produced statistics against these thresholds.
Success criteria SC‑002 (Ospan improvement) are not linked to a task that asserts the required effect‑size and p‑value conditions.
Success criteria SC‑003 (PSS‑10 reduction) are not covered by a verification step in the task list.
Success criteria SC‑004 (PANAS improvement) are not verified by any task.

Success criteria SC‑005 (Holm‑Bonferroni family‑wise error control) are not explicitly checked by a task; the pipeline produces corrected p‑values but no test asserts they meet the α = 0.05 family‑wise threshold.
